title: Poco Loco
price_note: Low season AED 2,450 per hour · High season AED 3,450 per hour · Preferential B2B rate
highlights: DJ booth, sound system and turntables included
Lounge interior and open-air upper deck with bar

description:
Poco Loco is a 90ft party yacht built in 2023 and based at Dubai Islands Marina, designed for birthdays, celebrations and corporate events of up to 75 guests.

The main deck is a lounge with velvet seating, a bar and screens, while the upper deck opens to the sky with a bar, lounge areas and a dance floor facing the DJ booth. A full sound system with turntables and three screens inside and outside are included.

Guests enjoy Wi-Fi on board and free parking at the marina, and drinks packages can be added on request.

Contact Yacht Research for availability and a tailored quote.
